card_title: The Perfect Roast Pull Temp Calculator: When to Pull Brisket, Duck, and Venison Off the Heat
card_excerpt: The fourth free, local-first kitchen utility — pick the meat, the cut size, and your target doneness, and it returns the exact temperature to pull from the heat. Hardcoded carryover logic for the cuts the internet ruins: brisket, duck breast, venison, and delicate fish.

card_title: Why More Home Cooks Should Batch Broths: The Single Best Habit I've Ever Built
card_excerpt: Homemade broth is cheaper than the cheapest boxed broth and tastes better than the most expensive. Roast bones (don't par-boil), double-strain, fridge-skim, and reduce a quart into demi-glace cubes for the freezer.
